newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to auction federal investment bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to auction federal investment bonds.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Sunday it had invited bids up to Tuesday for the auction of three-year, five-year and 10-year maturity federal investment bonds.
The result of the auction will be announced on Wednesday with settlement set for Thursday, the bank said.

In the previous auction on September 26, the bank accepted bids worth 100.30 million rupees at par for three-year maturity bonds, 52.50 million rupees at par for five-year bonds and 104.175 million rupees at par for 10-year maturity bonds.
